# S11 live-local evidence

NOT RUN in this repository snapshot. This directory is reserved for a local
run of the public Runtime server plus the external `stablepay-agent-eval`
client. Do not treat replay fixtures or this placeholder as live DeepSeek,
payment-service, Devnet, or crash/restart evidence.

When services are available, write only redacted outputs here (or under
`.local-run/s11`): `episode_results.jsonl`, `grade_results.jsonl`,
`metrics.json`, and `report.md`. Keep API keys, DSNs, private keys, and artifact
bodies out of the directory.
